name: Send Pending Identity Verification Code
summary: The user requests the NuvIoT verification code and the ceremony advances to the code-entry surface while remaining authorization-limited to the PendingIdentity.

preconditions.expression: the OAuth-external PendingIdentity requires email verification and has no normal application authorization

serverInteraction.intent: Issue the independent NuvIoT email-verification proof and begin PendingIdentity verification.

postconditions.expression: the PendingIdentity verification operation is active and a valid email-verification code has been issued

sourceReferences.note: Approved authentication policy requires independent NuvIoT email proof before an unlinked external provider may be linked to an existing durable identity; provider email is supporting evidence only.
